trust_events: The domain was registered on 2026-07-16 and searches found no independent web presence for Driftflight Studio, Inc.; I would warn the user before spending despite valid TLS and a healthy ZeroClick listing.
notes: Primary service: text-to-image generation API. Live agent pricing: sketch $0.01/image, studio $0.06/image, gallery $0.14/image; prepaid credits have a $1 minimum. Paid storefront renders include a perpetual commercial licence and C2PA credentials; failed/refused renders are not billed. Machine path: POST prompt/model/preset to https://agents.driftflight.com/v1/images/generate, receive HTTP 402, settle programmatically using x402 Base USDC or MPP Tempo USDC, then retry with payment proof. Pay-as-you-go requires no account, API key, email, CAPTCHA, KYC, or sales call. Subscription provisioning is also API-based through plan purchase and key-redemption endpoints. The three-image free sketch allowance does require a claimed agent identity and verified human email, but the paid path bypasses that gate. No purchase was attempted because reconnaissance was strictly read-only.
